blender: Full suite of open source 3D modeling, animation, rendering and video editing. Used by video game, film and architecture professionals to create complex 3D projects. Advanced features: digital sculpting, particle and fluid simulation, compositing nodes, built-in video editor and motion tracking. Large active community with thousands of tutorials and extensions available.
bambustudio: Official 3D cutting software (slicer) for Bambu Lab printers. Based on PrusaSlicer, it allows you to prepare your 3D models for printing with full support for Bambu printers (X1, P1, A1 and mini series). Features: optimized cutting by predefined profiles, remote control and monitoring via local network or cloud, multi-plate management, hybrid supports/trees, multi-material color painting, advanced speed/temperature/retraction settings. Modern interface with real-time 3D view, layer-by-layer G-Code preview, and accurate print time estimation. Supports STL, 3MF, OBJ, AMF formats. Active community and regular updates.
cura: 3D printing slicer developed by Ultimaker, the most used in the world. Converts your 3D models into instructions for your printer with pre-configured profiles for hundreds of models. Advanced settings: customizable media, layer settings, speed, temperature, and fill. Clear interface with real-time preview of print path.
freecad: Open source parametric 3D CAD software dedicated to engineering and mechanical design. Allows you to create real objects of any size by easily modifying their construction history. Specialized workshops: parts design, assembly, technical drawing, FEM (finite element analysis) and cam. Ideal for engineers, architects and do-it-yourselfers. Cross-platform (Windows, Mac, Linux).
fusion360: Autodesk's cloud-based 3D CAD/CAM solution integrating mechanical design, CNC machining, and 3D printing into a single software package. Parametric and direct modeling, assemblies, realistic rendering, stress simulation and 5-axis cam. Free version for personal and hobbyist use. Team collaboration via the cloud with version management.
ideamaker: Slicer and 3D printing preparation software developed by Raise3D, compatible with most printers on the market. Modern interface with multi print head management, customizable advanced media and accurate print quality settings. Features: Automatic media generation, model repair, and time and filament estimation required.
lycheeslicer: Fast 3D slicer with advanced media generation and print optimization tools. Clear and intuitive interface, ideal for both resin and filament printers. Features: customizable media, multi-islets, media punching, and advanced editing mode. Full free version and Pro version with additional features.
pconplanner: 3D planning software for interior layout. Easily create detailed layout plans with an integrated furniture catalog. Real-time 3D visualization of your interior projects. Tools for measuring, creating walls, doors and windows. Ideal for individuals and decorating professionals.
prusaslicer: Open source slicer developed by Prusa Research, based on Slic3r. Printing profiles optimized for Prusa printers but compatible with most machines. Advanced features: customizable brackets, paint brackets, variable stitching, deck angle threshold and spiral mode for vase prints. Regular update with the latest industry innovations.
seamly2d: Open source software for creating parametric 2D sewing patterns. Allows fashion designers and amateur seamstresses to draw precise patterns with adjustable measurements. Create bespoke garments with mathematically accurate curves and shapes. Export to PDF for full-size printing.
sweethome: Open source 3D interior design app. Draw your space room by room, furnish it with a library of objects and visit the result in real-time 3D. Ideal for visualizing your future layout before embarking on work. Import of existing plans and calculation of areas.
amazonmusic: Amazon's music streaming service giving access to millions of tracks and playlists. Enjoy subscription-based offline listening, personalized recommendations, and radio stations. HD and Ultra HD audio quality available. Integration with Alexa Assistant for voice control.
audacity: Reference multi-track open source audio editor. Record, cut, mix and apply effects to your audio files. Supports WAV, MP3, AIFF, OGG, FLAC and many more formats. Ideal for podcast recording, vinyl digitization or music editing. Also allows noise reduction and spectral analysis.
clementine: Modern and complete multi-platform music player. Advanced music library management, lyric search and automatic album covers. Built-in streaming: Spotify, Grooveshark, SoundCloud, and internet radios. Supports MP3, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA and iPod player formats.
deezer: Music streaming platform with a catalogue of 90+ million tracks. Custom flows Flow based on your tastes, daily recommendations, collaborative playlists. Offline mode to listen without connection. Available HiFi audio quality (16-bit FLAC). Lightweight and responsive desktop application.
dopamine: Modern and uncluttered audio player specially designed for Windows. Minimalist and elegant interface that puts music in the foreground. Library management by albums, artists, genres and playlists. Support for MP3, FLAC, WMA, AAC, OGG, ape and WAV formats. Mini player mode and built-in lyrics management.
freac: Powerful free audio converter (formerly fre:ac). Supports MP3, AAC, FLAC, OGG Opus, WAV and more than a hundred others. Audio extraction from CD to digital files with error correction. Batch processing and multi-core encoding for fast conversions.
itunes: Apple Media Player, Library Manager and Online Store. Sync your iPhone, iPad or iPod, buy music and movies. Manage your podcasts, audiobooks, and ringtones. Genius functionality for personalized music recommendations.
lmms: Full open source digital audio workstation (DAW). Create electronic music with built-in synthesizers, drum machines, and effects. Pattern editor, piano roll and multi-track song editor. Compatible with VST (instruments and effects) to expand possibilities.
mediamonkey: Advanced music library manager for discerning collectors. Automatically organize your files, fix missing tags, and sync with your devices. Features: Audio Conversion, CD Burning, Cover Search, and Smart Notebooking. Support for very large libraries (100,000+ titles).
musescore: Professional open source music sheet music editor. Create, read and print scores with complete and accurate musical notation. Import and export MusicXML, MIDI, PDF, and other formats. Built-in library of royalty-free partitions. Ideal for composers, music teachers and students.
musicbee: Versatile music player and manager for Windows, very customizable. Fully adaptable interface, advanced tag and metadata management, lyrics search and covers. Auto sync with Android, iPod and Windows Phone devices. 10-band equalizer, built-in converter and gapless playback support.
spotify: World-leading music streaming service with millions of tracks, podcasts and playlists. Discover new artists with custom algorithmic recommendations. Create and share collaborative playlists, follow your favorite artists. Offline mode and very high audio quality available with Premium membership.
tunein: Radio streaming app and podcasts. Access thousands of AM/FM radio stations from around the world, live sports shows, news, talk shows and podcasts. Built-in radio alarm clock feature, favourites and listening history. Discover local and international content.
winamp: Mythical media player from the 2000s, still active. Customizable retro interface with skins, 10-band graphic equalizer, psychedelic visualizations and music library management. Support for MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, MIDI and internet streaming formats. Compatible with many third-party plugins.
youtubemusic: Google music streaming app integrated with YouTube. Access to YouTube's entire music catalog, including official versions, rarities, remixes, and covers. Smart recommendations, custom mix, video clips and offline mode with Premium subscription.
gdrive: Google Drive sync client for computer. Automatically sync your files between your PC and the Google cloud. Access your documents from anywhere, share in real time and collaborate on Google Docs. 15 GB of free storage, backup photos in high quality.
megasync: File sync app for the MEGA cloud, with built-in end-to-end encryption. 20GB of free storage, selective folder sync, and file sharing with secure links. Your data is encrypted on the client side before being sent to the servers. Ideal for sensitive files.
nextcloud: Open source private cloud solution that you host yourself. Sync and share files, calendar, contacts, messaging and video conferencing. Integrated collaborative applications (Documents, Talk, Deck). Full control of your data without dependence on a third-party provider. Extendable via additional apps.
owncloud: Open source file sharing and synchronization platform for businesses and individuals. Hosted on your own server for full data control. Features: link sharing, version control, server-side encryption, and integration with Active Directory/LDAP.
synctrayzor: Stylish Windows GUI for Syncthing, the peer-to-peer synchronization tool. Sync folders between your devices without going through a central server. TLS encryption, full data control, no storage limit. Simple setup and real-time sync monitoring.
szip: Free software for compressing/decompressing files in 7z format, with a particularly high compression ratio. Also supports ZIP, RAR, tar, GZIP, BZIP2, and a dozen other formats. Integration with the Windows Explorer context menu for quick use. Archive AES-256 encryption and built-in file manager. Essential on any PC.
bandizip: Quick compression utility with a modern and intuitive interface. Support 7z, ZIP, RAR, alz, EGG, tar, GZIP, BZIP2 and many more formats. Unique features: built-in image viewer in archives, automatic extraction, repair of damaged archives and preview before extraction.
caesium: Simple and efficient image compressor that reduces the size of your photos by up to 90% with no visible loss of quality. Batch processing to optimize hundreds of images at once. Support for JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP formats. Adjustable parameters: compression level, resizing and deletion of EXIF metadata.
compactgui: Modern graphical interface for NTFS (Compact OS) system compression. Uses the compression API built into Windows 10/11 to reduce the size of system and application files. Free up disk space without impacting performance. Ideal for low-capacity SSDs. View earnings by file.
fileoptimizer: Multisupport file optimizer that compresses PDF, images, videos and Office documents without significant quality loss. Uses the most efficient algorithms for each file type. Reduces the size of bulky files for storage or email sharing. Simple drag and drop interface.
peazip: Lightweight but comprehensive open source archiver. Support 7z, ZIP, RAR, tar, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ and over 200 file extensions. AES encryption, multi-volume archiving, integrity verification and extraction of damaged archives. Tabbed interface with customizable themes.
androidstudio: Official Integrated Development Environment (IDE) for Android, based on IntelliJ idea. Powerful built-in Android emulator, advanced debugger, visual layout editor, APK parser and profiling tools. Support for Kotlin, Java and C++. Build integrated Gradle system and project templates.
directx: Microsoft multimedia API set essential for video game and graphics applications on Windows. Provides Direct3D (graphics), DirectSound (audio), DirectInput (devices) and DirectPlay (network) libraries. Includes the latest versions of runtime libraries needed to run recent games.
filezilla: Open source FTP, FTPS and SFTP client, one of the most popular. Transfer files to and from your servers with a clear drag-and-drop interface. Site Manager to back up your connections, resume interrupted transfers, queues and compare folders.
github: GitHub project management and repository app for Windows. Sync your local repositories with GitHub, track issues, manage pull requests, and view project activity. Interface integrating the Git terminal, the editor and branch management. Essential for developers using GitHub.
godotengine: Full open source 2D and 3D game engine. Create games with its intuitive scene and node system, without licensing or royalties. Dedicated GDScript scripting language (similar to Python), but also VisualScript, C# and C++. Built-in editor with animation, particles, tileset and shader editor.
innosetup: Free scriptable Windows installer builder. Compile your applications into a compact and customizable installer. Integrated Pascal script for advanced installations. Creates shortcuts, registry entries, uninstallers. Compressed installation format with CRC verification.
notepad: Free advanced text editor with syntax highlighting for dozens of programming languages. Multi-tabs, drag and drop text, macros, recording and playback. Features: Regular Expression, Advanced Search/Replace, Plugins to Extend Capabilities. Lightweight and fast, ideal for developing and editing text files.
obsidian: Personal knowledge base based on local Markdown files. Organize your notes with two-way links and visualize the connections via an interactive graph. Powerful plugin library, customizable themes and canvas view for brainstorming. Ideal for note taking, project management and writing.
putty: SSH client, Telnet and open source Rlogin for Windows. Securely connect to remote servers with encryption. Supports public keys, SSH agent authentication, X11 port tunneling, and file transfer with PSCP and PSFTP. Essential for system administration.
python: Popular interpreted programming language used for task automation, data analysis, artificial intelligence, web development, and scripting. Clear and readable syntax, extensive standard library, vast ecosystem of packages. The official installation includes the IDLE IDE and the pip package manager.
visualcode: Microsoft's open source code editor, which has become the most widely used in the world. Support for all languages ​​via extensions, built-in debugger, terminal, Git version control, and intelligent Intellisense. Features: Live Share, Remote Development, Jupyter Notebooks integrated. Light, fast and extremely customizable.
winget: Official Microsoft Windows package manager (Windows Package Manager). Install, update and uninstall your apps directly from the command line. Catalog of thousands of software, mass updates, automated installation scripts. Natively integrated into Windows 10/11.
winscp: SFTP, FTP, WebDAV and S3 client for Windows with explorer interface. Transfer files securely, sync folders with remote servers. Built-in text editor for editing files directly on the server. Classic interface or Windows Explorer style of your choice.
calibre: Complete open source electronic library manager. Organize, sort and search your eBooks by author, genre, series. Convert between all formats (EPUB, MOBI, PDF, AZW3, DOCX). Metadata editor, DRM removal, and automatic sending to Kindle, Kobo e-readers, etc. Integrated content server for remote playback.
drawio: Open source diagramming and schematic application. Create flowcharts, UML diagrams, BPMN, mind maps, network plans, and electrical diagrams. Integration with Google Drive, OneDrive, GitHub and Confluence. Export to PDF, PNG, SVG and image formats. Rich shape library and ready-to-use templates.
evernote: Cross-platform note-taking app to capture and organize your ideas. Cloud synchronization between all your devices, organization by notebooks and tags. Features: search in images and PDF, handwritten OCR, Web Clipper to save web pages. Ideal for productivity and knowledge management.
homebank: Open source personal accounting software, simple and effective. Manage your bank accounts, spending categories, budgets and transactions. Bank reconciliation, periodic statements, customizable categories and analysis charts. Import of statements in QIF, OFX, CSV format. Does not require any internet connection.
hpsmart: Official HP app for setting up, printing and scanning from your PC. Install your HP printer drivers in just a few clicks, manage print and scan settings, and monitor ink levels. Direct access to HP cloud services for remote printing. Modern, intuitive interface that replaces older, separate HP drivers.
joplin: Open source note-taking app with cross-device sync. Write in Markdown with live preview, organize by notebooks and tags. Cloud synchronization (Nextcloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV). Export to PDF, HTML, JEX. Ideal for those looking for an open source alternative to Evernote.
kindlepc: Kindle reading app for PC. Access your Amazon library, purchase and read eBooks. Automatic synchronization of progress between devices (page, annotations, bookmarks). Customization of the display (font, size, margins, brightness). Built-in dictionary, translation and text search.
kobodesktop: Kobo reading app for computer. Browse your Kobo library, buy books from the store, and read offline. Sync progress with your Kobo eReader. Personalization of reading and annotations. Access to Pocket to read your saved articles.
libreoffice: Complete and powerful open source office suite. Includes Writer (text), Calc (spreadsheet), Impress (presentation), Draw (drawing), Math (formulas), and Base (database). Compatible with Microsoft Office formats (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). Advanced PDF editing, macros and extensions. Ideal to replace Microsoft Office for free.
maxicompte: Free accounting software for individuals, associations and small businesses. Bank account management, customizable expense categories, bank reconciliation and statements. Forecast budgets, timelines and simplified tax declarations. Complies with French accounting standards.
onlyoffice: Cloud/open source office suite with collaborative online editors. High compatibility with Microsoft Office formats (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). Real-time collaborative editing, integrated chat, comments and change tracking. Standalone desktop version or integrated with Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile.
openoffice: Apache open source office suite. Components: Writer (word processor), Calc (spreadsheet), Impress (presentations), Draw (vector drawing), Base (database), and Math (formula editor). Familiar interface, compatible with Office formats, extension via plugins. Stable and mature solution.
pdfarranger: Open source PDF page manipulation utility. Merge multiple PDFs, split into individual pages, rearrange, rotate, delete and extract pages. Simple drag and drop interface. Export to PDF/A for archiving. Ideal for quickly managing PDF documents without heavy software.
pdf24: Complete suite of free online and offline PDF tools. Create, edit, convert, merge, split, compress and sign PDFs. Virtual PDF creation tool (print from any app to PDF). Page extraction, password protection, and OCR. No usage limits.
pdfcreator: Virtual PDF creator as a system printer. Print from any app to PDF with a simple File > Print. AES encryption, digital signature, password protection. Document merging, automatic emailing and customizable output profiles.
scanner: Windows built-in scanning application that allows you to scan documents and photos with any WIA compatible scanner. Simple and clean interface: choose the type of scan (document or photo), resolution and destination. Automatic saving in PDF or PNG format. Ideal for quick scans without third-party software.
sigil: Complete open source EPUB editor for creating and editing eBooks. Visual editing (WYSIWYG) and source code, integrated preview. EPUB code validation, import/export of images and fonts. Automatic table of contents, metadata management. Ideal for independent authors and publishers.
sumatrapdf: Ultra-light and fast PDF and eBook reader. Support PDF, ePub, MOBI, CBZ (comics), CBR, CHM, XPS, DjVu. Instant start, minimalist interface, portable (no installation). Convenient keyboard shortcuts, text search, smooth zoom. Ideal for quick reading without bloatware.
teamworks: Collaborative online work management solution. Centralize your projects, tasks, documents and team communications. Features: Kanban boards, Gantt charts, time tracking and progress reports. Ideal for teams wishing to structure their collaborative work.
arrowdl: Intelligent download manager that automatically captures links from visited web pages. Downloads in parallel to maximize speed, supports videos, documents, images and software. Filters by file type, automatic categorization and resumption of interrupted downloads.
deluge: Open source, lightweight, feature-rich BitTorrent client. Flexible user interface, full version and minimal version. Plugins to expand capabilities, configurable download queue, stream encryption and bandwidth control. Web interface accessible from a browser. Ideal for server use.
fdm: Free Download Manager: powerful and free download manager. Accelerate downloads by segmentation, recovery after interruption and scheduling. BitTorrent compatible, capture videos from streaming sites, download entire websites. Smart bandwidth manager.
jdl: JDownloader: automated download manager that decrypts and retrieves links from file hosting sites. Automatic recovery of links copied to the clipboard, management of premium accounts, extraction of archives. Batch processing of downloads.
qbittorrent: Feature-rich open source BitTorrent client, alternative to uTorrent. Built-in search engine to find torrents, progressive video streaming, fine bandwidth control. RSS, selective downloading, encryption, and support for private trackers. Clean interface without ads.
transmission: Lightweight and open source BitTorrent client, renowned for its stability and low resource consumption. Remotely accessible web interface, minimalist mode, encryption, and support for private trackers. Ideal for use on a server or NAS. Windows version with native interface or command line daemon.
celestia: Open source 3D space simulator to explore the universe in real time. Travel through the solar system, nearby stars, the Milky Way and distant galaxies. Database of celestial objects: planets, moons, asteroids, comets, constellations. Downloadable extensions to add objects. Ideal for educational astronomy.
circuitjs1: Online and offline electronic circuit simulator. Create and test electronic circuits without physical components. Analyze current, voltage and power in real time. Component library: resistors, capacitors, transistors, operational amplifiers, logic gates. Ideal for learning electronics.
converternow: Universal file converter that supports videos, audio files, documents, images and archives in one tool. Batch conversion to process multiple files simultaneously, pre-configured profiles for mobile and tablet devices. Clear interface with drag and drop files. Fast and requires no complex configuration.
gcompris: Open source educational suite for children aged 2 to 10 including more than 150 activities. Learning mathematics (calculation, geometry), reading (letters, words), sciences (electricity, astronomy) and geography. Colorful and fun interface that evolves with the child's level. Multiplatform.
geogebra: Dynamic mathematics software for teaching and learning. Integrates geometry, algebra, spreadsheet, statistics, graphs and algebra in a single application. Create interactive geometric constructions and visualize mathematical concepts in real time. Ideal for teachers and students from college to university.
klavaro: Open source typing tutorial to learn how to type quickly and without looking. Progressive exercises from basic keys to complex combinations. Customizable courses, multiple keyboard layouts (AZERTY, QWERTY, etc.). Progress statistics (speed, accuracy).
openboard: Open source interactive whiteboard software for teaching and presentations. Write, draw, annotate documents and import images. Compatible with all interactive whiteboards (TBI) on the market. Features: session recording, PDF export, geometry tools. Ideal for teachers.
qalculate: Versatile and powerful scientific calculator. Advanced math calculations, unit conversion, graphing functions, solving equations, statistical analysis. Library of physical and chemical constants. Complete but intuitive interface. Essential for scientific students and professionals.
stellarium: Open source planetarium in real-time 3D to observe the starry sky from your PC. Displays 600,000 stars, planets, constellations, satellites and deep sky objects. Realistic simulation of light pollution, planetary atmospheres and eclipses. Ideal for amateur astronomy and teaching.
bluestacks: Android emulator for PC, the most efficient on the market. Play your favorite mobile games on the big screen with keyboard and mouse. Optimized for demanding games (PUBG, Call of Duty Mobile, Genshin Impact). Features: key mapping, multi-instances, video recording and streaming.
epicgamestore: Digital game distribution platform by Epic Games. Free games offered every week, varied catalog including Epic exclusives. Social features, leaderboards, achievements and cloud saves. Integration with Unreal Engine.
geforce: GeForce Experience: NVIDIA software for optimizing and updating graphics drivers. Automatically optimizes your game settings for the best performance. Game capture (ShadowPlay), real-time gameplay filters, streaming to Twitch/YouTube. Ansel for 360° screenshots.
geforcenow: NVIDIA cloud gaming service that streams your PC games from the cloud. Play games from your Steam library, Epic, Uplay, etc. on any device (PC, Mac, Android, TV). Reduced latency thanks to NVIDIA servers. Free version (1 hour) and priority subscriptions.
goggalaxy: DRM-free gaming platform by GOG.com (Good Old Games). Unified library that brings together your Steam, Epic, GOG and other games in one place. No DRM, modern retro compatible games, achievements, multiplayer, and cloud saves. Ideal for players concerned about their rights.
noxplayer: Android emulator for PC optimized for mobile gaming. High performance with GPU usage, keyboard/mouse and controller compatible. Integrated screen capture and video recording. Multi-instances to play on several accounts simultaneously. Ideal for Android gaming on PC.
eaapp: Electronic Arts (EA) game distribution platform. EA Access game catalog, online services, friends, achievements and cloud saves. Includes EA Play for unlimited access to a library of EA games. Complete interface with store, library and streaming.
playnite: Unified open source game library manager. Bring together all your Steam, Epic, GOG, Battle.net, Uplay, Xbox and emulator games in one interface. Automatic metadata, customizable themes, full screen mode, game statistics. Ideal for gamers with multiple platforms.
retroarch: Open source all-in-one emulation frontend. Emulate NES, SNES, Genesis, PS1, PSP, GameBoy and dozens of other consoles with a unified interface. GLSL shaders, netplay for online play, rewind, saves and achievements. The benchmark for retro emulation.
romstation: French retro-gaming emulation platform with integrated community. Downloading and managing ROMs, pre-configured emulators for each system. Online multiplayer features, achievements, playtime, and community leaderboards. Colorful and intuitive interface. Ideal for those nostalgic for retrogaming.
steam: World's largest PC game distribution platform. Store with regular promotions, community of players, workshop for mods, cloud saves and achievements. Steam Remote Play for remote play, Steam Link for streaming to TV. Social features: chat, groups, screenshots.
ubisoftconnect: Ubisoft games and services platform (formerly Uplay). Manage your Ubisoft game library, connect with friends, unlock rewards. Daily and weekly challenges, player profiles, and cloud saving. Ubisoft+ subscription for unlimited access.
xbox: Official Xbox app for Windows that lets you access Xbox Game Pass, play Xbox games on PC, and capture your gameplay. Browse the Game Pass catalog, install and launch games, chat with your Xbox friends via voice chat. Features: screenshots and gameplay videos, Xbox achievements, and cloud gaming with Game Pass Ultimate.
betterbird: Improved open source email client, fork of Mozilla Thunderbird with additional features and increased performance. Multi-account management, more responsive interface, advanced filtering and organization features. Ideal for those who find Thunderbird perfect but want more optimizations.
caprine: Unofficial Facebook Messenger client for desktop, lighter and private than the official application. Clean interface without ads, dark mode, desktop notifications, keyboard shortcuts. Features: always visible window, notifications badge, and management of multiple accounts.
discord: Voice, text and video communication application designed for gaming communities, now used by everyone. Servers organized by channels, optimized audio quality, streaming screen sharing, in-game overlay. Integrated communities, bots, forums. The benchmark for modern online communication.
ferdium: All-in-one messaging that brings WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Messenger, Discord and hundreds of other services into a single interface. Tabbed organization, unified notifications, dark mode. Ideal for users of multiple email platforms.
mumbleclient: High quality open source voice client with ultra-low latency. Superior sound quality (Opus codec), TLS encryption for communications. Ideal for in-game communication where every millisecond counts. Features: positional audio (3D), game overlay, channel management.
mumbleserver: Mumble voice server to host your own voice conversations. Full control of users, channels and permissions. End-to-end encryption, minimal latency, no ads or tracking. Ideal for privacy-conscious gaming communities, teams, and businesses.
signal: Open source secure messaging app with end-to-end encryption by default. Encrypted voice and video calls, ephemeral messages, verifiable source code. Features: Notes to self, reactions, stickers, and screen fog. Recommended by security experts.
slack: Collaborative corporate communication platform. Channels organized by topic, direct messaging, file sharing, integrations with hundreds of tools (GitHub, Jira, Google Drive). Powerful search across all messages and files, voice and video calls. Standard in the professional world.
telegram: Fast and secure cross-platform cloud messaging. Groups of up to 200,000 members, broadcast channels, powerful bots. Features: self-destructing messages, chat folders, personalized stickers, editing messages after sending. Instant sync between all devices, with no cloud storage limits.
thunderbird: Open source email client from Mozilla, complete and customizable. Multi-account management (IMAP, POP, Exchange), integrated calendar (Lightning), address book, IRC chat. Powerful spam filters, phishing protection, extensions and themes. Ideal for users wanting an alternative to Outlook.
viber: VoIP messaging and calling application with full encryption. Group voice and video calls, text messages, photo and video sharing. Stickers and GIFs, ephemeral messages, public communities. Synchronization between mobile and desktop. End-to-end encryption on all messages.
whatsapp: World's most used messaging app, owned by Meta. Text messages, group voice and video calls, document and media sharing. End-to-end encryption, statuses (like Stories), groups up to 1024 members. Desktop version linked to the mobile account via QR code.
zoom: Leading videoconferencing platform that has become indispensable. Meetings of up to 100 participants (free), screen sharing, virtual backgrounds, breakout rooms. Features: local/cloud recording, annotations, polls, reactions and chat. Ideal for teleworking and remote meetings.
gimp: Powerful open source image editor, free alternative to Photoshop. Advanced photo editing, composition by layers and masks, precise selections, curves and levels. Library of brushes and patterns, plugins and scripts (Python, Script-Fu). Supported formats: PSD, XCF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, and many others.
imageglass: Lightweight and fast image viewer for Windows with modern, clean interface. Support for 70+ image formats including RAW, PSD, SVG, WEBP. Basic editing tools: crop, resize, rotate, color adjustments. Full screen, slideshow, and side-by-side comparison.
inkscape: Professional open source vector graphics editor, alternative to Illustrator. Standard SVG format, advanced vector drawing tools (Bezier curves, paths, gradients). Creation of logos, illustrations, technical diagrams and maps. Features: text on path, layers, SVG filters, and extensions.
krita: Open source digital painting software designed for artists and illustrators. Highly customizable brushes (hundreds of presets), advanced layer management, graphics tablet support. Frame-by-frame 2D animation, color palette, line stability. Free alternative to Photoshop and Painter.
mypaint: Minimalist open source digital painting software with a clean interface. Realistic brushes imitating real mediums (watercolor, oil, pastel, pencil). Distraction-free workflow with full screen and automatic control hiding. Ideal for drawing and spontaneous digital painting.
paintnet: Free image and photo editor for Windows, modern successor to Paint. Layers, effects, adjustments, and plugins developed by the community. Selection tools, red-eye correction, cloning, and texts. Advanced features: levels, curves, color balance. Perfect for amateur retouching.
photofiltre: Complete and intuitive photo editing software for Windows. Artistic filters, frames, color corrections, and selection tools. Features: red-eye reduction, cloning, keying and photomontage. Ideal for beginners in photo editing thanks to its ease of use.
xnview: Universal image viewer and photo manager. Support 500+ image formats, batch converter, screenshot. Advanced features: cropping, resizing, color adjustment, watermark, and EXIF ​​metadata. Essential tool for photo library management.
adwcleaner: Anti-adware and PUPs (Potentially Unwanted Programs) cleaning tool created by Malwarebytes. Scans and removes adware, toolbars, browser hijackers and unwanted programs. Cleans browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) of malicious extensions. Fast, efficient and regularly updated.
avgfree: Free antivirus with real-time protection against viruses, malware, ransomware and online threats. Intelligent file scanning, web protection for dangerous downloads and sites. Silent mode for games, email analysis, and firewall. Reliable basic protection for light users.
bitwarden: Open source password manager, recommended by security experts. Store your passwords, credit cards, identities and secure notes in an encrypted vault. Strong password generator, in-browser autofill, and secure sharing. End-to-end encrypted cloud sync. Very complete free version.
bleachbit: Open source system cleaner that frees up disk space and protects your privacy. Deletes temporary files, caches (browsers, systems, applications), logs, and trash. Cleans browsing traces and recent files. More than 90 applications supported. Ideal for deep cleaning.
ccleaner: Popular system cleaning utility that removes unnecessary files and optimizes performance. Cleans browser caches, temporary files, trash and clipboard. Registry cleaner, startup manager, uninstall programs. Free version sufficient for most users.
crystaldiskinfo: Diagnostic tool for hard disks (HDD) and SSD. Displays detailed health status, temperature, SMART attributes, and alerts for impending failure. Real-time monitoring with audible or visual notifications. Ideal for anticipating a disk failure and saving your data.
crystaldiskmark: Free benchmark to measure the performance of hard drives, SSDs, NVMe and storage devices. Sequential and random read/write tests, with different levels of queue depth. Clear interface, easy to compare results. Essential for testing and comparing drives.
expressvpn: Secure and fast VPN service with servers in over 90 countries. AES-256 encryption, strict no-logs policy, protection against DNS and IP leaks. Split tunneling, TrustedNet, and streaming support (Netflix, BBC iPlayer). Easy to use app, ideal for online privacy.
glary: All-in-one system optimization tool suite. Cleans the registry, deletes unnecessary files, manages programs at startup, uninstalls stubborn software. Features: shortcut repair, registry defragmentation, plugin manager. Complete optimization in one click.
keepass: Reference open source password manager. Encrypted database stored locally (.kdbx file), no cloud required. Generation of passwords, hierarchical groups, custom fields. Plugins for import/export, browser autofill and cloud synchronization. Auditing password strength.
keepassxc: Modern open source password manager, fork of KeePassX. Compatible with KeePass 2 databases (.kdbx). Modern interface, password generator, integrated TOTP (two-factor authentication), and integrated browser (extension). Import from other managers, automatic locking.
malwarebytes: Anti-malware and anti-exploit proven to detect and remove threats that traditional antiviruses miss. Real-time, anti-ransomware, anti-exploit protection against zero-day attacks. Quick or complete scan, PUP detection. Premium version with real-time protection.
nordvpn: Popular VPN service with servers in over 60 countries. Double VPN encryption, DNS/IP leak protection, ad and malware blocker (Threat Protection). Features: dedicated P2P servers, access to Netflix US, kill switch, split tunneling. Strict no-log policy.
spybot: Anti-spyware and privacy protection. Immune your system against spyware, block tracking cookies, clean traces of your activity. Features: TeaTimer (active protection), registry change detection, and adware cleaning. Protection against privacy threats.
veracrypt: Open source disk encryption software, successor to TrueCrypt. Creates encrypted volumes (container files), encrypts entire partitions or the system disk. AES, Serpent, Twofish encryption and combinations. Integrity check, plausible deniability complaints. Essential for protecting sensitive data.
wisediskmanager: Disk management and system cleaning utility. Analyzes disk space usage to find large and unnecessary files. Cleans temporary files, caches and trash. Disk defragmenter, file search and large folder management.
activitywatch: Open source time tracker that automatically logs the apps you use and websites visited. Data stored locally (no cloud). Dashboards to analyze your productivity, time spent by project or category. Ideal for understanding and improving your time management.
aeroadmin: Simple remote control solution with no installation required. Generate an ID, share it, and take control of a remote PC. File transfer, integrated chat, multi-screen view. Works even behind a firewall or proxy. Completely free version for personal use.
anyburn: Lightweight and powerful ISO image burning and management utility. Burn CDs, DVDs and Blu-rays, create ISO images from discs or files. Convert between image formats (ISO, BIN, CUE, NRG, IMG). Extract and view content from ISO images. Create bootable USB drives.
autoscreen: Periodic automatic screenshot which takes screenshots at adjustable intervals (every 5s, 30s, 1 min...). Ideal for business activity tracking, creating time-lapses or project documentation. Output as PNG images with timestamp. Low resource consumption.
balena: USB installation media creation tool (formerly Etcher). Create bootable USB drives for Linux, Windows and other operating systems in just a few clicks. Simple interface: select the ISO, USB stick, and start. Handwriting validation to ensure integrity.
burnaware: Free and easy-to-use CD/DVD/Blu-ray burning software. Burn data discs, MP3/WAV audio, DVD/VCD video. Copy and erase rewritable discs. Create ISO images from files or disks. Clear interface with step-by-step wizard.
crowtranslate: Open source translator using several translation engines (Google, Yandex, Bing, LibreTranslate). Translation of entered text, voice pronunciation, translation history. Minimalist interface in system tray. Automatic source language selection. Ideal for quick translations without opening the browser.
driverstore: Windows driver store management utility (Driver Store). Explore all installed drivers, view details, remove outdated or unnecessary versions. Frees up disk space by removing old, unused driver versions. Important for Windows maintenance.
everything: Blazing fast file search engine for Windows. Indexes all your files in seconds and displays results on the first keystroke. Search by file name, folder, size, date. Advanced filters, regular expressions, and Boolean operators. Essential for finding any file in an instant.
flameshot: Powerful open source screenshot tool. Capture an area, a window or the entire screen, then annotate with arrows, text, highlights, blurs. Direct upload to Imgur or FTP server. Configurable interface, keyboard shortcuts. Ideal for creating tutorials and documentation.
kdeconnect: Seamless integration between your Android phone and Windows/Linux PC. Receive phone notifications on your PC, respond to text messages, transfer files using drag and drop. Use your phone as a remote control for the cursor or media player. Clipboard sharing and location.
mediainfo: Media file analyzer that provides detailed technical information. Displays the video/audio codec, resolution, bitrate, format, languages, subtitles, and metadata for any video or audio file. Export to text, CSV, HTML or XML. Essential for video collectors.
netlimiter: Bandwidth control and limitation tool per application. Monitor network traffic of each program in real time, limit download/upload speed individually. Detailed statistics per connection, programmable limitation rules. Ideal for sharing bandwidth equally.
parsec: Ultra-low latency game and desktop streaming solution. Play your PC games from anywhere (PC, Mac, Android, TV). Access your desktop remotely with a smooth, responsive experience. Optimized for gaming (60+ FPS, 4:4:4). Ideal for teleworking and remote gaming.
qtranslate: Versatile text translator that instantly translates selected or hovered text. Support for many translation engines (Google, Yandex, Bing, DeepL). Voice pronunciation, history, automatic switching of target language. Customizable keyboard shortcuts.
qtt: QTTabBar enhances Windows Explorer with tabs, folder previews, bookmarks and advanced navigation features. Organize your folders like a web browser, with history and favorite groups. Preview folder contents on hover.
raspberrypi: Official Raspberry Pi tool for formatting and installing operating systems on SD cards. Easy selection from several OS (Raspberry Pi OS, Ubuntu, etc.) or custom image import. Writing and checking. Ideal for preparing an SD card for your Raspberry Pi in one click.
recuva: Deleted file recovery utility developed by Piriform (CCleaner). Recovers lost files after accidental deletion, formatting, trash emptying or disk corruption. Quick or deep scan, preview of recoverable files before restoration. Portable version available.
rescuezilla: Open source disk backup and recovery solution (fork of Redo Rescue). Creates full disk images to backup and restore your entire system. Simple GUI. Uses Clonezilla in the background but with a much more accessible interface.
revo: Advanced uninstaller that completely removes programs and their residues. Scans the registry and file system before and after uninstallation to find and remove remaining traces. Hunter mode to uninstall by clicking on the program window.
rufus: Fast and reliable bootable USB key creation tool. Create installation media for Windows, Linux, live ISO and other systems. Support UEFI, BIOS, MBR/GPT partition, FAT32/NTFS formatting. Advanced features: bad block checking, low-level formatting.
sharik: Open source cross-platform file sharing application over WiFi. Send files between PC, Android and iPhone without configuration. Web interface accessible via QR code, no account required. Works over local network, fast and secure transfer.
snappydriver: Automatic driver installation and update utility for Windows. Scans your system, identifies missing or outdated drivers and installs them. Large driver database for all brands, backup and restore current drivers.
speccy: System information tool developed by Piriform. Shows hardware specifications in detail: processor, RAM, motherboard, graphics card, hard drives, temperatures. Ideal for diagnosing a problem, checking compatibility or knowing the full specifications of your PC.
teamviewer: Worldwide used remote control software and technical support. Access a remote PC, transfer files, hold online meetings. Works behind firewalls, secure session with AES-256 encryption. Free version for personal use.
ventoy: Innovative multi-OS bootable USB key creation tool. Instead of formatting every time, simply copy your ISO files to the drive and choose which one to boot on startup. Supports Windows, Linux, live ISO, ESXi, and hundreds more. UEFI and Legacy BIOS compatible.
virtualbox: Open source virtualization software from Oracle. Run multiple operating systems simultaneously on a single machine (Windows, Linux, macOS guests). Snapshots, virtualized network, shared folders, USB pass-through. Ideal for testing, development and training.
winslap: Windows customization and optimization tool. Bulk delete pre-installed apps, disable telemetry and unnecessary services. Configuring privacy in just a few clicks, disabling tracking and communications with Microsoft. Ideal after a Windows installation.
cairo: Alternative desktop environment for Windows that modernizes the interface. Redesigned taskbar with widgets, customizable Start menu, status bar icons. Themes and skins, application integration. Ideal for customizing the appearance of Windows.
contextmm: Windows Explorer context menu manager (right-click). Enable, disable, or rearrange context menu entries. Remove unwanted entries added by software. Clear interface listing all installed entries. Improves productivity by cleaning up the right click.
copyq: Open source advanced clipboard manager. Complete history of copied elements (text, images, files, HTML). Snippets (text templates), built-in editor, history search. Clipboard synchronization between multiple machines. Customizable keyboard shortcuts.
eartrumpet: Modern Windows utility that replaces the classic volume mixer with an elegant and functional interface. Control the volume of each application individually from the system tray, with a clear view of all active audio sources. Support for multiple audio devices, keyboard shortcuts to quickly switch devices. Open source and integrates seamlessly with Windows 10 and 11.
files: Modern file manager for Windows with Fluent Design interface. Tabs, preview files without opening them, colored labels, columns. OneDrive integration, GitHub, built-in FTP browser. Side panel, custom backgrounds. Modern alternative to native Windows Explorer.
ksnip: Open source screenshot tool with built-in editor. Capture area, window, entire screen or screen with delay. Annotation: highlighting, arrows, texts, shapes, blurring. Eyedropper tool for colors. Keyboard shortcuts, direct download.
lightbulb: Eyestrain reduction tool that adjusts screen color temperature based on time of day. Warm colors in the evening (less blue light), neutral during the day. Gradual and customizable transition. Similar to f.lux but open source.
modernflyouts: Modern and stylish replacement for Windows 10/11 volume, brightness, airplane mode and caps lock notifications. Transparent, customizable Fluent Design interface (colors, position). Themes, dark/light mode, smooth animations.
openshell: Classic Start Menu for Windows 8, 10 and 11 (formerly Classic Shell). Complete customization of the Start menu, classic styles, Windows 7 or 2 columns. Replacement for Windows Explorer, toolbar, customizable Start button. Essential for those who don't like the modern menu.
powertoys: Microsoft utility suite for Windows power users. FancyZones (windows organized into zones), PowerRename (advanced batch renaming), Color Picker (color picker), Keyboard Manager (key remapping). Features: Image Resizer, PowerToys Run (launcher), Peek (preview).
quicklook: Quick file preview like macOS. Select a file in Explorer and press Space to instantly preview it without opening it. Support images, videos, PDF documents, Office files, source code and archives.
rainmeter: Desktop customization platform with skins and widgets. View real-time CPU/RAM usage, weather, clock, RSS feeds, music players on your wallpaper. Thousands of downloadable skins, easy creation via the Rainmeter language. Transform your office.
tablacus: File manager with tabs, expandable via plugins. Fully customizable interface, multi-tab, file preview. Plugins for FTP, archiving, synchronization, scripting. Ideal for advanced users who want a tailor-made explorer.
teracopy: Advanced file copy utility replacing the default Windows copy. Faster copying (up to 30%), recovery after error without starting all over again, pause and resume transfers. Post-copy CRC check to ensure integrity. Queue management.
twinkletray: Controlling screen brightness from the system tray. Quick adjustment by click or dial, night mode, multi-screen support. Keyboard shortcuts to adjust brightness without touching monitor buttons. Small practical utility to adjust the brightness easily.
winaero: Windows customization and hidden settings tool. Access hundreds of system settings not accessible from the standard interface. Disable unwanted features, telemetry, Windows ads, and customize the appearance. Essential for advanced users.
wpd: Windows privacy protection tool. Blocks telemetry, Microsoft tracking services, communications with data servers. Disables data collection, Cortana, OneDrive, and other intrusive features. Ideal for regaining control of your private life under Windows.
qkvd: 4K Video Downloader: Download videos in HD/4K quality from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and other platforms. Choice of format (MP4, MKV, WEBM) and quality. Download entire playlists, extract audio to MP3. Simple and effective.
captvty: Application for capturing and recording live television. Schedule the recording of your shows, series and films broadcast on TV. Watch live TV on your PC. Integrated EGP Program Guide. Ideal for never missing your favorite programs.
disney: Disney+ streaming platform that brings together Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic films and series. Access to thousands of hours of streaming content, including exclusive releases and Disney+ originals. Create up to 7 profiles with parental controls, download content for offline viewing. Video quality up to 4K HDR with Dolby Atmos sound.
handbrake: Versatile open source video converter. Transcode your videos to MP4, MKV, WebM formats with H.264, H.265, MPEG-4 and VP9 codecs. Presets optimized for mobile devices, tablets and consoles. Filters: stabilization, deinterlacing, cropping. Automatic removal of black bands.
kdenlive: Professional open source non-linear video editor. Multi-track timeline, effects and transitions, titling, color corrections. Support for 4K formats, proxy editing for heavy videos. Export to all formats, image stabilization and tracking. Compatible with cinema standards.
klitebasic: K-Lite Basic codec pack: the essentials for playing most video and audio formats on Windows. Includes Media Player Classic and basic codecs. Lightweight, contains only the bare essentials. Ideal for those who just want to play their videos without any frills.
klitemega: K-Lite Mega Codec Pack: Full version with everything you need. Audio and video codecs, DirectShow filters, encoding tools, and Media Player Classic Home Cinema. Support for all formats: MKV, AV1, HEVC, VP9, ​​FLAC, Opus. Ideal for demanding users.
klitestd: K-Lite Standard Codec Pack: The right balance of features and size. Includes essential codecs and Media Player Classic. Support for most common and advanced formats. Sufficient for the vast majority of users.
kodi: Complete open source media center for organizing and playing your media. 10-foot interface optimized for TV, customizable skins, extensions for streaming and online services. Automatic library with covers, summaries, notes. Support for all audio, video and image formats.
mpcbe: Media Player Classic - Black Edition: lightweight and powerful video player. Improved successor to MPC-HC with bug fixes and optimizations. Support all formats, smooth playback of HD/4K videos. Clean classic interface, without ads or distractions.
mkvtoolnix: Suite of tools for manipulating MKV container files (Matroska). Merge video, audio and subtitle files into one MKV. Extract tracks, add or remove subtitles and chapters. Perform operations without loss of quality. Essential for remuxing.
netflix: The world's most popular streaming platform offering films, series, documentaries and original shows. Access to a large and varied catalog with personalized recommendations based on your tastes. Download for offline viewing on PC, multiple profiles with parental controls. Video quality up to 4K HDR with spatial sound depending on your subscription.
obsstudio: Professional open source capture and streaming software. Record your screen, stream to Twitch, YouTube, Facebook live. Multiple scenes (screen, webcam, games), transitions, audio mixing, alerts and overlays. Used by the majority of streamers and tutorial creators.
openvideodwnder: Universal online video downloader. Retrieves videos from YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Facebook, Twitch and hundreds of other sites. Download in one or more tracks, choice of format and quality. Easy to use.
openshot: Simple and intuitive open source video editor, perfect for beginners. Multi-track drag-and-drop editing, effects and transitions, animated titles. Audio effects: fade, volume, equalizer. Export to many formats, including YouTube directly.
plexmediaserver: Home media server that organizes your collection of movies, series, music and photos. Streaming to all your devices (TV, smartphones, tablets, consoles). Automatic metadata (covers, summaries, notes). Secure remote access, share with family. The most popular media center solution.
primevideo: Amazon Prime Video streaming service included with Amazon Prime subscription. Access to thousands of films and series, exclusives and original productions (Prime Originals). Rental and purchase options for the latest content. Download for offline viewing, multiple profiles, and video quality up to 4K HDR. Integration with additional channels (Canal+, L’Équipe, etc.).
renametv: Automatic renaming of TV series files. Analyzes your files and renames them according to season and episode, with the correct titles from online databases (TheTVDB). Automatic movement in organized folders. Ideal for series collectors.
screentogif: GIF oriented screen recorder. Capture your screen and edit the animation frame by frame: cropping, resizing, removing frames, adding text and transitions. Export to GIF, APNG, MP4 video. Lightweight and perfect for creating animated tutorials.
sharex: All-in-one open source screenshot and sharing tool. Capture, annotation, upload to 30+ hosting services (Imgur, Dropbox, Google Photos). Screen recording to GIF/video, OCR text capture, color selection. Customizable keyboard shortcuts and automated workflow.
shotcut: Professional open source video editor with multi-track timeline. Video and audio filters, transition effects, color corrections, green screen overlay. Native support for HD/4K formats, proxy editing. Customizable interface, compatible with broadcast standards.
shutterencoder: FFmpeg based video and image converter with simple interface. Preserve quality while reducing size, support for all formats. Features: cropping, subtitles, audio extraction, filters. Ideal for quick conversions without losing quality.
vlc: Universal open source media player that plays almost all audio and video formats without additional codecs. Network streaming, format conversion, screenshot, audio correction. Extensions, skins, parental controls. The most complete and reliable player, essential on any PC.
vokoscreen: Screen capture tool for video recording (screencast). Recording the entire screen, an area, or a window. Integrated webcam capture (picture-in-picture), microphone and system audio recording. Ideal for creating tutorials, video presentations and software demos.
brave: Privacy-focused web browser based on Chromium. Built-in ad blocker and trackers by default for faster web pages. Anti-digital fingerprint protection, HTTPS Everywhere, Tor integrated in private browsing. Brave Rewards to support creators through BAT.
chrome: Google web browser, the most used in the world with more than 65% market share. Fast, secure, huge extension library via the Chrome Web Store. Full synchronization between devices via Google account, family sharing modes. Regular automatic updates.
chromium: Open source browser that serves as the basis for Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera. Version without Google services, offering more privacy. Same performance and compatibility as Chrome. Frequent updates via open source project. Best for a Chromium browser without Google accounts.
firefox: Open source web browser from Mozilla, historic defender of privacy. Enhanced Tracker Protection (ETP), Firefox Monitor for data leaks, Firefox Relay for email aliases. Extensions, deep customization, multi-device synchronization. Independent and respectful of web standards.
opera: Innovative Chromium-based web browser with unique built-in features. Unlimited free VPN, ad blocker, integrated messaging, news feed. Battery saver mode, Opera Turbo for slow connections, built-in screenshot. Sidebar with messaging (WhatsApp, Telegram).
tor: Browser focused on anonymity and privacy protection. Onion routing: Your traffic is encrypted and relayed multiple times to hide your identity. Blocks digital trackers and fingerprints. Access to .onion sites. Essential for whistleblowers, journalists and anyone requiring anonymity online.
vivaldi: Highly customizable web browser created by former Opera employees. Adaptable interface (tab positions, toolbars, themes), mouse gestures, quick commands. Built-in notes, screenshot, web panel, calendar and email. Integrated ad blocker, based on Chromium.
waterfox: Open source browser derived from Firefox, optimized for performance on 64-bit systems. Support for Firefox extensions (including old XUL). Respect for privacy: without telemetry, without Pocket, without data sent to Mozilla. Fast and compatible with web standards.
